description: Size the read buffer in CoderStore.text from the chat file size so chats over 4 MB open cleanly.

steps.send: In `apps/openagents-desktop/Store.swift`, `CoderStore.text(_ id: String)` allocates a fixed `4 * 1024 * 1024` byte buffer, causing chats larger than 4 MB to fail to open. Compute the on-disk file size of `dir.appendingPathComponent(id + ".json").path` via `FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath:)` and allocate `max(4 * 1024 * 1024, size + 64 * 1024)` bytes. Verify syntax with `swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/Store.swift`.

graders.run: swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/Store.swift && grep -q 'attributesOfItem' apps/openagents-desktop/Store.swift && grep -q '64 \* 1024' apps/openagents-desktop/Store.swift
